# Persyst Feature Families - Generated Facts

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync_persyst_docs.py from the code registries (constants.FEATURE_FAMILIES, cadence.FAMILY_ENGINE_MAP, export._FAMILY_UNITS / _GROUP_FAMILIES, data_checks.FAMILY_VALUE_RANGES) + the committed MMX. Do not edit by hand - run the script. -->

This is the **machine-checkable contract** for Persyst feature families. The narrative docs (`PERSYST_V10_REFERENCE.md`, `DATA_DICTIONARY_v4.md`) and the Obsidian vault cite this table; they must not restate these values. A drift test (`tests/test_persyst_doc_sync.py`) fails if this file is stale vs the code.

| Family | Unit | Engine | Export group | Value range | In MMX |
|---|---|---|---|---|:---:|
| `adr` | ratio of µV amplitudes (dimensionless); clamped at Ratio Max 10. NOT a power ratio — equals the square root of a conventional power-based ADR, so do not compare directly to published values. | `FFTEngine01` | core | 0-100 | yes |
| `aeeg` | µV (peak-to-peak) | `aEEG01` | core | 0-500 | yes |
| `alpha_variability` | RAV: 6–14/1–20 Hz ratio of µV amplitudes (dimensionless); clamped at Ratio Max 10 | `FFTEngine01` | core | - | yes |
| `annotation` | text | `-` | - | - |  |
| `artifact_detector` | - | `-` | - | - |  |
| `artifact_intensity` | muscle: µV (per Persyst 2026-08-20; help text says µV² — unconfirmed). V-Eye / L-Eye: probability 0.0–1.0 | `Artifact01` | electrode_detail | 0-50 | yes |
| `asymmetry` | % (EASI 0–100 magnitude; REASI −100 to +100, + = right>left) | `FFTEngine01` | asymmetry_spectrogram | -1-1 | yes |
| `asymmetry_spectrogram` | % (−100 to +100) per bin | `-` | - | -100-100 | yes |
| `coherence_spectrogram` | coherence (0–1) | `-` | coherence_spectrogram | 0-1 | yes |
| `display` | - | `-` | - | - | yes |
| `electrode_quality` | dimensionless, 0=clean → 1.0; >1.0 = above impedance disconnect threshold. Clamped at the MMX display Maximum (1.2 in this template) | `Artifact01` | electrode_detail | 0-1.2 | yes |
| `fft_power` | µV (amplitude; MMX PowerType=1 — NOT µV² power) | `FFTEngine01` | core | 0-500 | yes |
| `fft_power_ratio` | ratio of µV amplitudes (dimensionless); clamped at Ratio Max 10 | `FFTEngine01` | core | 0-100 |  |
| `fft_spectrogram` | µV/√Hz (amplitude spectral density = √(µV²/Hz); Persyst label 'sqrt(µV)/Hz'; square to get PSD µV²/Hz) | `FFTEngine01` | fft_spectrogram | - | yes |
| `heart_rate` | bpm | `-` | core | 0-300 | yes |
| `peak_envelope` | µV | `PeakEnvelope01` | core | 0-500 | yes |
| `rda` | rhythmicity index | `RhythmicityEngine01` | core | - |  |
| `relative_power` | band/broadband ratio of µV amplitudes (dimensionless); clamped at Ratio Max 10. NOT conventional relative power (band power ÷ total power) — equals its square root. | `FFTEngine01` | core | 0-1 | yes |
| `rhythmic_delta` | boolean (0/1) | `RhythmicityEngine01` | core | 0-1 |  |
| `rhythmicity` | rhythmicity index | `RhythmicityEngine01` | rhythmicity | - |  |
| `rhythmicity_spectrogram` | rhythmic spectral amplitude (µV/Hz) | `-` | - | - | yes |
| `seizure_burden` | % (0–100) or category code per variant | `-` | core | 0-100 | yes |
| `seizure_detection` | boolean (0/1) | `SeizureProbabilityP1401` | core | 0-1 | yes |
| `seizure_notification` | boolean (0/1) | `SeizureProbabilityP1401` | core | 0-1 |  |
| `seizure_probability` | probability (0–1) | `SeizureProbabilityP1401` | core | 0-1 | yes |
| `sleep` | sleep stage code | `-` | core | - | yes |
| `spectral_edge` | Hz | `FFTEngine01` | core | 0-50 | yes |
| `spike_density` | spikes/sec | `SpikeDensityV101` | core | - | yes |
| `status_epilepticus` | binary (0/1) or % (0–100) per variant. PERCENT variants floor at 0.050331, never 0; advanced and combined are identical — see docs/DATA_DICTIONARY_v4.md | `-` | core | 0-100 | yes |
| `suppression_ratio` | % (0–100) | `Amplitude01` | core | 0-100 | yes |
| `time_display` | timestamp | `-` | - | - |  |
